description: Picard's newly assembled Enterprise-D crew begins exploring the Federation frontier under Q's scrutiny, encountering unfamiliar civilizations while Data, Worf, Troi and the human officers establish the identities that will define the ship.

s01e01-02.description: Captain Picard assembles the new Enterprise crew under Q's judgment of humanity and investigates the strange secret behind Farpoint Station.

s01e03.description: A contagious form of intoxication spreads through the Enterprise, stripping away inhibitions while the crew races to stop the ship from sharing another vessel's fate.

s01e04.description: Tasha Yar is drawn into a ritual combat after a planetary leader kidnaps her during negotiations for a desperately needed vaccine.

s01e05.description: A confrontation with the Ferengi is interrupted when both ships are trapped by an ancient outpost whose guardian judges the intruders by unfamiliar standards.

s01e06.description: A propulsion experiment hurls the Enterprise beyond known space into a region where thought and reality blur, while Wesley recognizes the mysterious Traveler's unusual abilities.

s01e07.description: Energy beings infiltrate the Enterprise during a diplomatic mission, altering crew behavior and ultimately drawing Picard toward a dangerous new form of existence.

s01e08.description: Wesley faces execution for accidentally violating an idyllic planet's absolute law while the Enterprise encounters the powerful being protecting its inhabitants.

s01e09.description: A Ferengi captain returns Picard's former ship, the Stargazer, as part of a revenge plot that forces Picard to relive a celebrated battle.

s01e10.description: Q grants Riker extraordinary powers to test whether a human can resist reshaping reality for the people he cares about.

s01e11.description: Troi's arranged marriage is interrupted by the arrival of a plague ship carrying a woman whose connection to her fiancé challenges both duty and destiny.

s01e12.description: Picard, Data and Crusher become trapped in a malfunctioning Dixon Hill holodeck program where fictional gangsters suddenly have genuinely lethal weapons.

s01e13.description: The Enterprise discovers Data's disassembled twin, Lore, whose charm conceals a link to the crystalline entity that destroyed their colony.

s01e14.description: Riker negotiates on a matriarchal world where male fugitives from a Federation ship have become political dissidents threatening the planet's social order.

s01e15.description: The Bynars secretly commandeer the Enterprise during a computer upgrade, while Riker and Picard become absorbed in an unusually sophisticated holodeck character.

s01e16.description: An elderly admiral takes an experimental rejuvenation treatment before negotiating with a hostage-taker who knows the darker truth behind his celebrated past.

s01e17.description: A sterile civilization abducts children from the Enterprise, forcing Picard to uncover why the apparently advanced society can no longer reproduce.

s01e18.description: Terraformers are accused of murder after the Enterprise discovers microscopic crystalline life whose intelligence has been overlooked by the project destroying its habitat.

s01e19.description: Wesley undergoes Starfleet Academy testing while Picard becomes the target of a secret investigation into alleged command irregularities.

s01e20.description: Worf is torn between Starfleet duty and Klingon identity when the Enterprise rescues warriors who reject peace with the Federation.

s01e21.description: An away team becomes trapped on a deserted world where an automated weapons system continues demonstrating products long after its creators are gone.

s01e22.description: Two neighboring civilizations depend on a trade relationship that appears essential until Crusher discovers one population has been deliberately kept chemically dependent on the other.

s01e23.description: A rescue mission on a barren world brings the crew face to face with a malicious being made from the discarded darkness of an ancient species.

s01e24.description: A scientist's experiment fractures time across the Enterprise while Picard encounters a woman whose relationship with him ended before his Starfleet career.

s01e25.description: Picard follows warnings from fellow captains into a covert investigation of Starfleet Command, uncovering a parasitic infiltration reaching the highest levels.

s01e26.description: The Enterprise revives three humans frozen since the 20th century while investigating destroyed outposts near the reactivated Romulan Neutral Zone.
